mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_logs (admin_id, action, target_type, target_id, target_label, detail, result) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetLabel}, #{detail}, #{result})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, u.nickname, l.action, l.target_type, l.target_id, l.target_label, l.detail, l.result, l.created_at FROM admin_logs l LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.admin_id ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
